# `api.jobs.shipment.book_v2`

> `POST /job/{jobDisplayId}/shipment/v2/book` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.shipment.book_v2(job_display_id: int, **kwargs: Any) -> ShipmentBookingResult
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs shipment book_v2 <job_display_id> [--body ...]
```

Book one explicit ``quote_id`` using the 8_01 contract.

Supply the last observed ``job_modified_date`` for conflict detection.
``shipment_id`` in the result is a carrier ID, not a shipping record ID.

## Request body — `BookShipmentRequestV2`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
| `forceUpdate` | `bool` | no | Allow an overwrite-policy conflict override; refresh-policy conflicts still require a fresh read. |
| `quoteId` | `UUID` | yes | Quote UUID from a shipping record or selected transportation quote; never a shipping ID. |
| `shipOutDate` | `datetime` | no | Requested shipment date and time; required by non-UPS carriers. |
| `internationalParams` | `Optional[JobExportDataInput]` | no | International params. |
| `carrierSpecificParams` | `Optional[BookShipmentSpecificParamsInput]` | no | Carrier specific params. |
| `documentByteCodeRequired` | `bool` | no | Document byte code required. |
| `handlingUnitFreightClasses` | `Optional[list[str]]` | no | Handling unit freight classes. |
| `continueOnValidationError` | `bool` | no | Continue on validation error. |

## Response

Returns `ShipmentBookingResult`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `success` | `Optional[bool]` | no | Success. |
| `errorMessage` | `Optional[str]` | no | Error message. |
| `shipmentId` | `Optional[str]` | no | Carrier shipment identifier; distinct from Shipping.id and quoteId. |
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
